gloss: concise and clear; plain and simple

definitions.gloss: concise and clear; plain and simple
definitions.explanation: Describing writing, speech, or explanations that are both brief and easy to understand. Combines the ideas of simplicity and clarity.

examples.japanese: {簡明|かんめい}な{説明|せつめい}。
{簡明|かんめい}な{文章|ぶんしょう}を{心|こころ}がける。
examples.english: I try to write in a clear and concise style.

examples.japanese: {複雑|ふくざつ}な{制度|せいど}を{簡明|かんめい}にまとめた{資料|しりょう}が{配|くば}られた。
examples.english: Materials that summarized the complex system clearly and concisely were distributed.

notes: A na-adjective used primarily in written and formal contexts. Not to be confused with the homophone {感銘|かんめい} (deep impression). Common collocations include {簡明|かんめい}な{文章|ぶんしょう} (clear writing), {簡明|かんめい}な{説明|せつめい} (clear explanation), and {簡明|かんめい}にまとめる (to summarize concisely). The four-character compound {簡潔明瞭|かんけつめいりょう} conveys the same meaning more emphatically.
